name: snapmaker-studio-desktop
description: Snapmaker Studio — the local-first workflow platform for modern 3D printing. Understand any design, check if it will print, get it ready, and monitor your Snapmaker U1.

scripts.release:linux: npm run build:sidecar:linux && tauri build --bundles deb && npm run debianize:linux
scripts.debianize:linux: bash -c 'deb=$(find src-tauri/target/release/bundle/deb -maxdepth 1 -name "*.deb" -print -quit); if [ -z "$deb" ]; then echo "No .deb found to debianize" >&2; exit 1; fi; bash ./scripts/debianize-version.sh "$deb"'
